fields.description:
## Problem

The working amd64 Jira Data Center harness only boots inside a CI runner (arm64 hosts stall
under emulation — `tests/external/live_jira_dc/README.md`). So every live DC reconcile
observation currently costs a full ~2h push→CI cycle, which makes root-causing live-only DC
defects (e.g. bug `reckless-diabolic-kob` — rich-text stored as `None` + perpetual re-emit)
prohibitively slow.

## Approach

Reuse the EXISTING agentic-in-CI pattern (`scripts/jira_dc_capability_map.py` +
`.github/workflows/jira-dc-capability-map.yml`, ticket 259b): boot the ephemeral DC ONCE, then
run an Opus agent on rebar's own `rebar.llm` runtime that performs MANY live experiments in
that single boot. Where capability-map's agent drives raw REST to *map* the image, this one
drives rebar's OWN reconcile primitives to *root-cause* a defect.

New files (test + CI only — no `src/rebar` change):
- `tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_dc_richtext_agentic_probe.py` — an opt-in pytest module
  that reuses the proven `bound_dc_issue` fixture chain (so the agent starts from the exact
  `(repo, local_id, key)` the failing rich-text tests use, cutover `dc` on) and boots the
  agent with two tools: `run_python(code)` (a persistent in-process REPL warm-started with the
  transport, `compute_update_fields`, `WikiTextCodec`, `cutover_clients`, `dc.run_bridge`,
  `rebar`) and `jira_rest(method, path, body)` (raw REST ground-truth). Returns a structured
  `RichTextRca` finding, each experiment cited to evidence ids.
- `.github/workflows/jira-dc-richtext-probe.yml` — a `workflow_dispatch`-only driver, same
  guardrails as capability-map (throwaway ephemeral instance, `REBAR_MCP_READONLY=1`, agent
  instructed to REPORT not fix), installing `[dev]` (LLM runtime) + `[jira-datacenter]`
  (transport), uploading the finding + evidence artifact.

## Portability

The investigator is a **pytest module gated by env** (`REBAR_DC_RICHTEXT_PROBE=1` +
`REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1` + an LLM credential + the harness skip markers), so it runs against ANY
reachable live DC — a local `make jira-dc-up` instance or CI — not a single CI provider. The
GitHub Actions workflow is one convenient trigger, not the only path; a contributor with a
local DC + key runs the same test directly with `pytest`. It is inert on every ordinary run
(opt-in off → skips), never on push/PR/schedule.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] `test_dc_richtext_agentic_probe.py` exists, lint/format clean, and collects + skips
      cleanly when the opt-in env is unset (no live DC required for collection).
- [x] The module reuses the existing `bound_dc_issue` / `dc_store_copy_repo` / `dc_transport`
      fixtures rather than re-porting the bound-store bootstrap.
- [x] The agent is given `run_python` (persistent namespace) + `jira_rest` tools and returns a
      registered structured `RichTextRca` contract; it asserts only that a finding was
      produced (an investigation, not a correctness assertion — it must not fail merely
      because the bug still reproduces).
- [x] `jira-dc-richtext-probe.yml` is `workflow_dispatch`-only (no push/PR/schedule), boots
      the pinned DC image, installs both `[dev]` and `[jira-datacenter]`, requires an
      `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (loud fail if absent), sets `REBAR_MCP_READONLY=1`, and uploads the
      finding + evidence artifact.
- [x] [non-codebase] A `workflow_dispatch` run of the probe on `main` completes and uploads a
      `RichTextRca` finding with cited experiment evidence.
      provenance: environment=github-actions ubuntu-latest runner with the digest-pinned ephemeral Jira DC (run 33129851229, main); principal=github-actions workflow_dispatch job probe-jira-dc-richtext under the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY repo secret; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — Run 33129851229 concluded success and its jira-dc-richtext-probe artifact holds rca.json (all RichTextRca contract fields; 10 experiments citing 20 evidence ids) plus evidence.json (51 entries, kinds run_python + jira_rest).
